description:
Children are disposed with session.dispose() only. Extensions loaded in the child never get session_shutdown, so resources they own (interactive_shell PTYs, monitors) outlive the child, and their ExtensionAPI goes stale while still bound. Match pi's AgentSessionRuntime.dispose(): emit session_shutdown(reason quit), then dispose. Bounded so a hung handler cannot block teardown. Requires pi-interactive-shell with per-session coordinators (fork bkono/pi-interactive-shell@ca050c6, upstream PRs #96/#97); on npm 0.18.0 a child shutdown kills every shell in the process.

Done predicate: a real in-process child AgentSession disposed via the minion runtime emits session_shutdown(quit) to its extensions while its API is still active, then disposes; a hung handler does not block dispose past the bound; a throwing handler does not prevent dispose. Lint, tests, typecheck pass.
title: pi-minions: emit session_shutdown before disposing a child session
